evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL is in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Obliteration of posteiror horn of medial meniscus, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular cartilage of left knee, more severe at medial compartment, and subchondral edema and spur formation, reflecting osteoarthritis
evidence.Lateral OA: Wearing of articular cartilage of left knee, more severe at medial compartment, and subchondral edema and spur formation, reflecting osteoarthritis
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
evidence.Contusion: subchondral edema and spur formation, reflecting osteoarthritis
